Second-order analysis of A and B; environment (OMP=8, MKL_CBWR=COMPATIBLE, JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu, float64)
CO/6-31G CAS(6,6) 24 bit-exact degenerate pairs in the 400-determinant winning CI block; t241c health record
E13 defect record: blocked eigh on bit-exact degenerate pairs, CO winning block 24 pairs; A/B difference 10.76 kcal/mol
CO/6-31G CAS(6,6) health check: E=-112.7955083, |g|=5.2e-6, lambda_min=1.194e-2, n_neg=0

notes: The target is the lower of the two stationary points, B. A is 10.76 kcal/mol higher and carries a negative curvature direction; the energy and curvature criteria separate the branches.

The natural-occupation spectrum changes by 0.0264 between A and B, below the 0.05 occupation tolerance. The occupation criterion is therefore non-discriminating for this pair and is not used for acceptance.
The canonical interval is an exact gauge transform of the two-electron singlet reconstructed from the measured natural occupations. It is not a new electronic-structure calculation.
The 24-pair degeneracy belongs to the CO/6-31G CAS(6,6) CI block, a different active space. It is recorded as an out-of-scope related measurement.
